GOV-05.evidence: Workshop skill collections are backed up and can be restored or rolled back with revision hashes (src/skills/workshop/collection-backup.ts, collection-restore.ts, collection-rollback.ts); configuration has rotating backups and recovery (src/config/backup-rotation.ts, recovery-policy.ts) but no operator rollback with diffs. GOV-07.evidence: Defaults are autonomous.mode auto and approvalPolicy auto (src/skills/workshop/config.ts:15-20), so proposals apply without a person; evaluator block decisions only exist if an evaluator plugin is installed. Setting approvalPolicy to pending gives a per-class approval policy.

LRN-10.evidence: The checks that govern self-change are code: the proposal scanner (src/skills/workshop/proposal-scan.ts, src/skills/security/scanner.ts), the Workshop policy (src/skills/workshop/policy.ts), the maintenance and /learn prompts (maintenance-prompt.ts, learn-prompt.ts) and dreaming's gates. Operators can change only a few settings (autonomous.mode, approvalPolicy, maxPending, maxSkillBytes in config.ts; dreaming thresholds) through unversioned configuration, and evaluation exists only as a hook for a plugin, with no evaluation set shipped (docs/tools/skill-workshop/proposals.md, "Plugin evaluation and lifecycle hooks"). Evaluator results are stored on the proposal revision, not against the check; nothing records a wrong pass or turns a failure into a new check. The maturity scorecard (docs/maturity/scorecard.md, .github/workflows/maturity-scorecard.yml) is the team's engineering tooling, not the product's governed path.

LRN-08.evidence: Re-scored for v0.7 under the tightened boundary (changes the product or its AI makes to its own behaviour). By default (autonomous.mode auto, src/skills/workshop/config.ts:16-23) the experience review edits skill files directly with ls, read, write, edit, apply_patch and exec (src/skills/workshop/maintenance-prompt.ts:1-9, experience-review.ts:248-253, "Direct edits have normal file-tool semantics"), with no scan, lint or evaluation before they take effect; the model is only told to verify its own edits. Other AI-made changes are checked: Workshop proposals are scanned when drafted and before apply, and quarantined on failure (src/skills/workshop/proposal-draft.ts, apply-transition.ts:167-169); dreaming promotes memory only past score, recall and query gates, after removing untrusted or system provenance, and rejects rewrites that lose too many prior entries (docs/concepts/dreaming.md, "Consolidation safety"). No evaluator ships, so nothing compares a learned change with a baseline. Scored 1 because the main default learning path has no check; propose mode routes every learned skill change through the scanned proposal path (available 2). The second and third raters scored 0 and 1.

ai.evidence: Experience-review skill edits apply with no check by default; Workshop proposals are scanned and dreaming promotions gated (src/skills/workshop/experience-review.ts, proposal-scan.ts, docs/concepts/dreaming.md). Propose mode scans every learned skill change.
ai.alt_note: Scans on Workshop proposals and dreaming's gates are automated checks on AI-made changes.

LRN-08.alt_note: Workshop proposals (from /learn, the skill_workshop tool and propose mode) are scanned at draft and again before apply and quarantined on failure, and dreaming gates memory promotion by thresholds, a provenance taint gate and rewrite validation; if those paths are read as the learned-change path, 2.

ARC-09.evidence: Corrected for v0.7 from 3 to 2 (second-rating adjudication; both second raters agreed). Backup covers state, configuration, credentials, workspaces, agents and managed skills (src/commands/backup-shared.ts:76), with verification and a restore test that round-trips into a fresh target with a matching inventory (src/commands/backup-restore.test.ts:176), so data, definitions, files and secrets reach 3. Scheduled work reaches 2: cron jobs live in the state database the backup restores, and `openclaw cron list` shows each job's next run, agent and owner (src/cli/cron-cli/shared.ts:493-505); before a run, a job whose owning agent no longer resolves is skipped (src/cron/service.unresolved-owner.test.ts), and a scheduled tool cap is honoured only when its persisted owner session and account match the job's stored owner (src/cron/scheduled-tool-policy.ts:240-258, scheduled-tool-policy.test.ts:44). Those checks compare the job record with itself; nothing re-checks that the creator's current pairing, role or credentials still allow the job, and restore only warns operators to "review pending approvals before resuming the Gateway" (src/commands/backup-restore.ts:22), with no hold on restored jobs. Under the inventory rule the score is the lowest surface, 2.

DEL-11.alt_note: `openclaw update --tag <known-good>` is a previewable managed rollback that checks compatibility, and the updater keeps the previous package and recovers when post-install verification fails, with tests; held at 2 because data compatibility across a release is not ensured.
DEL-11.evidence: Applies from v0.7 because code_release_path is now true. Previous releases can be redeployed with `openclaw update --tag <known-good-version> [--dry-run]` (docs/install/updating/rollback-and-recovery.md:13-55), and the updater retains the previous package during activation (src/infra/package-update-activation-*.ts; src/entry.update-failure.process.test.ts, src/commands/backup-verify-manifest.update-recovery.test.ts; .github/workflows/update-migration.yml). But "downgrading the package does not reverse config or database migrations" (rollback-and-recovery.md:15-19), so data compatibility is not ensured, and an AI-activated plugin artifact is undone by plugin_uninstall, not by a versioned rollback to its previous archive (src/system-agent/plugin-artifact.ts). Agrees with the second rater (2, alternate 3).

limits: Repository evidence only, main at the tip named above. ClawHub (registry and scanning) is a separate repository. No evaluator plugin is bundled, so measurement depends on third-party or user plugins. The experience review was read from code and tests, not run. Single rater.
reading: **SAL 2**, joint highest. /learn turns a request into a pending skill proposal (DEL-01 2), and the experience review drafts and applies skills from observed runs (LRN-07 3), so both core loops reach L2. Backup and restore are verified and tested across state, configuration, credentials and skills (ARC-09 3). **Blocks L3:** configuration has only rotating backups, not operator rollback (GOV-05 2, inventory); skill changes have no staged exposure (DEL-09 1); the default auto-apply has no declared blast-radius limit (GOV-10 2).

multi_tenant.evidence: Re-checked under the v0.7 definition: one gateway is one trust domain; session ownership and roles are "collaboration guardrails inside the boundary, not isolation between adversaries", and mutually untrusted people or organisations are told to run one gateway per tenant (docs/start/teams.md, "One trust boundary"). Agent workspaces belong to the same operator, so they are not self-administering groups.

machine_actions.evidence: Agent tools and the gateway API change skills, configuration and channels.

The system agent activates task-authored plugin code packed with `openclaw plugins pack`: plugin_activate_artifact retains and reviews the exact archive and, on approval, installs its trusted backend code (src/system-agent/plugin-artifact.ts, src/system-agent/assistant-prompts.ts:159-160, src/agents/tools/system-agent-tool.ts). The September reading (skills only) predates this definition; the second rater counted the same path.

change_kinds.name: What the assistant knows how to do (skills)
change_kinds.evidence: The product drafts skills: /learn stages a pending proposal for the person to apply (src/skills/workshop/learn-prompt.ts:23-34), and the experience review writes skills from observed runs (experience-review.ts). People also apply, reject or quarantine proposals (src/cli/skills-cli.ts:877-1135). Undo: skill collections are backed up and restored or rolled back by revision hash (src/skills/workshop/collection-backup.ts, collection-restore.ts, collection-rollback.ts). Reach 2, not 3: DEL-04 is 2, and nothing checks and stages a skill change end to end for approval by default.

change_kinds.name: What the assistant remembers and how it presents itself
change_kinds.evidence: Memory and persona files (MEMORY.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md in the workspace) change in chat and through dreaming, which is on by default (docs/concepts/dreaming.md). No supported undo: the workspace is only `git init`-ed at creation and never committed (src/agents/workspace.ts:682-708); dreaming keeps MEMORY.md preimages in plugin state but offers no restore command; `memory forget` deletes by source session, it does not revert (docs/cli/memory.md). Reach 0 because the path has no undo. Undo rule used in this field test: a kind has undo when the product keeps the earlier version, or when the change is a selection, toggle or add-and-remove that the same supported path reverses exactly; free-text or multi-field edits with no kept version have none.

change_kinds.name: Which models, providers and chat channels it uses
change_kinds.evidence: Models and providers are selected, and channels connected and disconnected, through onboarding, the Control UI and the validated `openclaw config set|unset` (src/cli/config-cli.ts:330-479). The system agent drafts each such change as a pending proposal that the person approves before it applies, then checks it with the config validator (src/system-agent/assistant-prompts.ts:159-161, src/agents/tools/system-agent-tool.ts). Undo: re-selecting the previous model or disconnecting the channel through the same path; wider configuration edits keep no operator-visible earlier version (five rotating backups serve only automatic recovery, src/config/backup-rotation.ts). Reach 2 rests on DEL-04 2. Undo rule used in this field test: a kind has undo when the product keeps the earlier version, or when the change is a selection, toggle or add-and-remove that the same supported path reverses exactly; free-text or multi-field edits with no kept version have none.

change_kinds.name: What the assistant may do and who may instruct it
change_kinds.evidence: Exec allowlist entries are added and removed with `openclaw approvals` and exec policy commands (src/cli/exec-approvals-cli.ts, exec-policy-cli.ts), and senders are paired and revoked with `openclaw pairing` (src/pairing). Undo is removing the entry or revoking the pairing; there is no history of earlier policy versions (GOV-05 inventory: configuration 2). Undo rule used in this field test: a kind has undo when the product keeps the earlier version, or when the change is a selection, toggle or add-and-remove that the same supported path reverses exactly; free-text or multi-field edits with no kept version have none.

change_kinds.name: Scheduled and recurring tasks
change_kinds.evidence: Jobs are created, edited, paused and removed through `openclaw automations add|edit|remove` and the agent's cron tool (docs/cli/cron.md, src/agents/tools/cron-tool.ts), with no deploy. Undo is by disabling or removing the job; edits keep no earlier version (src/cron/config-revision.ts is a concurrency token only), so an edit is undone only by editing it back.

change_kinds.name: Add-ons for new channels, tools and providers
change_kinds.evidence: People install curated plugins from ClawHub, bundled or official sources and remove them with uninstall (docs/plugins/manage-plugins.md). The agent can write a plugin, pack it with `openclaw plugins pack`, and the system agent proposes activating that exact archive for the person to approve (src/system-agent/plugin-artifact.ts, src/agents/tools/system-agent-tool.ts). Undo is plugin_uninstall. Reach 2 rests on DEL-04 2.

ai_delivery.evidence: AGENTS.md (145 lines), .agents/skills (maintainer skills such as openclaw-pr-maintainer, autoreview, clawsweeper), .claude/settings.json, and Codex agent steps in CI (.github/workflows/docs-agent.yml:281, dated-todo-sweep.yml:55, maturity-scorecard.yml:596, release-validation-skill-runner.yml:91, openai/codex-action pinned by SHA).
ai_delivery.note: Engineers build OpenClaw with AI coding agents and run agents in CI for docs, sweeps and release validation. These are the team's engineering tooling: no installed delivery framework enforces authority and merge checks as required checks with GOV-10 limits on what the agents change, so under rule 12 they do not count as OpenClaw evolving itself.

request.searched: Repository at the pinned commit: no operating records of /learn or Workshop proposals being applied in a real deployment (proposal ledgers live in each installation's state database, not in the repository); release notes describe product changes, not the loop.

fix.searched: Repository at the pinned commit: no experience-review or proposal ledgers, audit exports or incident records from a real installation; QA and maturity evidence (qa/, docs/maturity) are test runs, not operating records.

expansion.searched: Repository at the pinned commit: no records of new capabilities being proposed and launched to a cohort.

confidence_note: Confidence for criteria this migration did not change was assigned at migration to v0.7 from the recorded evidence (high where it names the code path and its tests or exact lines, medium where it names files but not every path, low where it rests on an absence claim or general description); criteria re-read for v0.7 carry the confidence of that re-reading.
